titleEdited.description: Window title while the fiddle has unsaved changes. {{name}} is the fiddle's name.

cancel.description: Dialog button that cancels the action.

replaceMessage.description: Confirmation shown before another fiddle replaces one with unsaved changes.

replaceDetail.message: “{{name}}” has changes that haven't been saved.
replaceDetail.description: Detail of the discard confirmation. {{name}} is the fiddle's name.

discard.description: Button that throws away unsaved changes.

closeMessage.description: Confirmation shown when closing a window with unsaved changes. {{name}} is the fiddle's name.

save.description: Dialog button that saves the fiddle.

dontSave.description: Dialog button that closes without saving.

quitMessage.description: Confirmation shown when quitting while some window has unsaved changes.

quitDetail.message: Unsaved changes are kept as drafts and offered next time Electron Fiddle starts.

quit.description: Dialog button that quits the app.

openFolderTitle.description: Title of the folder picker used to open a fiddle.

open.description: Button of the folder picker used to open a fiddle.

saveFolderTitle.message: Choose a folder for the fiddle
saveFolderTitle.description: Title of the folder picker used to save a fiddle.

overwriteMessage.description: Warning before saving into a folder that already has fiddle files. {{folder}} is the folder name.

overwriteDetail.description: Detail of the overwrite warning. {{files}} is a comma-separated list of file names.

addFileMessage.description: Asked when a gist has a supported file that fiddles don't usually contain. {{name}} is the file name.

addFileDetail.message: Only add files you expect this gist to contain.

skip.description: Button that leaves a file out.

loadFailed.description: Error dialog title when a fiddle fails to load.

saveFailed.description: Error dialog title when saving fails.

offline.message: Your computer seems to be offline.
offline.description: Error detail when a load fails because of the network.

noSupportedFiles.message: This gist has no files Electron Fiddle can open.
noSupportedFiles.description: Error when a gist contains no supported files.

loadWarnings.description: Title of the notice listing load warnings.

warnPackageJson.message: package.json isn't valid JSON, so its modules and Electron version were ignored.
warnPackageJson.description: Load warning for an invalid package.json.

warnVersion.message: Electron {{version}} from package.json can't be used, so the current version was kept.
warnVersion.description: Load warning when package.json asks for an unusable Electron version. {{version}} is that version.

warnModules.description: Load warning listing module specs that were rejected. {{modules}} is a comma-separated list.

linkInvalid.description: Error title for a malformed electron-fiddle:// link.

linkNeedsNewer.message: This link needs a newer version of Electron Fiddle
linkNeedsNewer.description: Error title for an electron-fiddle:// link whose kind this version doesn't know.

linkGistMessage.description: Confirmation title before a deep link loads a gist.

linkDocsMessage.description: Confirmation title before a deep link loads an example from the Electron docs.

linkUntrusted.message: Only load code from sources you trust.
linkUntrusted.description: Line in the deep link confirmation reminding that the code is untrusted.

linkOwnerMismatch.message: Warning: the link names {{linkOwner}} as the owner, but the gist belongs to {{owner}}.
linkOwnerMismatch.description: Warning in the deep link confirmation when the owner in the link doesn't match the gist.

detailOwner.description: Line in a confirmation naming the gist owner's GitHub login.

detailDescription.description: Line in a confirmation showing the gist description.

detailRevision.description: Line in a confirmation showing the gist revision SHA.

detailVersion.description: Line in a confirmation showing the Electron version.

detailPath.description: Line in a confirmation showing the example's path in the electron/electron repository.

detailOrigin.description: Line in a confirmation showing where the fiddle came from.

detailFiles.description: Line in a confirmation listing file names.

detailDependencies.description: Line in a confirmation listing npm dependencies.

none.description: Shown in a confirmation line when a list is empty.

unknownOwner.description: Shown when a gist has no owner (anonymous gist).

trustMessage.description: Title of the approval shown before running code from a gist or the Electron docs for the first time.

trustDetail.message: This fiddle's code came from outside Electron Fiddle and can do anything your user account can. Only continue if you trust the source.

trustContinue.description: Button that approves running an untrusted fiddle.

trustAllowScripts.description: Checkbox in the trust approval that lets these packages run their install scripts. {{packages}} is a comma-separated list.

restoreMessage.description: Asked at startup when drafts from an earlier session were found.

restoreDetail.message: Electron Fiddle found unsaved changes from an earlier session: {{names}}.
restoreDetail.description: Detail of the restore question. {{names}} is a comma-separated list of fiddle names.

noRecent.description: Disabled item in the Open recent menu when there is nothing to show.

clearRecent.description: Item in the Open recent menu that clears the list.
